An encrypted vault designed around what happens to important records after their owner dies. The work explores how to organize private material and model the handoff to a designated recipient.

A proposed mixing workflow accepts a ZIP of multitrack stems and returns processed stems alongside a stereo mix. Keeping individual tracks available would let an engineer revise the result inside a session.

I built a CMake and JUCE scaffold with a VST3 target, pass-through audio and an output-gain control. This first milestone establishes the plug-in signal path. Mastering DSP and Audio Unit support are planned.
An Oregon Trail-inspired survival adventure built around travel decisions and resource pressure. Godot provides the framework for experimenting with encounters and their consequences.
A weekly survivor-pool research design brings injuries, weather and market movement into one comparison of matchup risk. The output is a reasoned pick with assumptions a reader can challenge.
Recurring agents look for business opportunities and assemble findings into reports. The design centers on defining what qualifies as a lead and giving the reader enough source context to follow up.

A print companion to Paranormal Atlas translates case files into illustrated spreads. Phoenix Lights and Dyatlov Pass provide subjects for exploring how maps, chronology and witness accounts can share a page.

My Los Angeles-based company brings full-stack development, paid acquisition and business automation together. Client work connects websites, analytics and internal processes to the way staff actually work.
